gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, its curve endings keeping well apart from one another. Offside, rope-like in every stem and widely tracked, commands the top.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Loose curves that refuse to close, nothing pinched. Offside keeps its shoulders full and widely spaced, while Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps open throats and a quiet, minimal cap-to-lowercase step.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sintony: Stencil-cut letters with mildly varied bar widths lead the way. Metamorphous leaves generous sidebearings, and Sintony, a sans-serif with a chunky, tall midzone, reads smooth with no clogged curves.
